steps.text: In their swift fall downwards, the hunters look just like—
—Shooting stars.
A sight that those who live in the deep seas rarely have the opportunity to witness.
With his desires and plans clouding his head, the bishop has, of course, never looked up at the night sky to enjoy that spectacle.
But they are different.

When the Abyssal Hunters had to fight for their lives and escape from the melancholy and sacrifice, they swam upwards, and when they finally reached the surface, they could only solemnly gaze upon the star-filled night sky...
The Hunters have all etched the destinies of these short-lived stars into their hearts.
Despite everything, the darkness can still be broken.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Now die.
Three shooting stars illuminate the deep passageway.
The bishop is horrified. But because it has neither lungs nor vocal tracts, this thundering sound is as close as it gets to a scream for its current body.

Amidst the debris and crumbling walls, the monster's bloated, dying form sprawls across much of the karst cave. Once emanating a strange, eerie beauty, its bizarre body now begins to stiffen in dread as it faces impending doom.

a.text: The bishop is dead, and he will be forgotten completely.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: This is bad.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: There's not a single living thing outside this city.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I don't think we're going to be able to restock our supplies here.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Anyone find anything?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Nothing on my end. The folks in the other parts of the city won't say a word either.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: They react when they see food, but won't answer any of my questions.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Don't even bother asking them for supplies. I've been giving out bits of whatever rations I had on me.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Things were mostly the same for me. The only word that comes to mind when I look at these houses is 'miserable.'

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hard to imagine how the locals can even live here.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, I've searched a few markets. Seems they're all long-abandoned.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Safe to say most people here haven't had a good meal in a long while.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Breaks my heart.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I followed someone to the coast, thinking I could find something there, but...

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Hrrh... Hrrh...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: He's just like the others, wandering aimlessly on the beach and sometimes digging through sand, as if there's food buried beneath.

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Hungry...

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Fins, shells, can eat.

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Eat, eat.
Senshi lays down his axe and nimbly makes his way in front of the pair, opening up the bundles they are carrying.
Within are piles of finbeasts and shells scavenged from the beach, but from the foul odor they emit, it's clear they've begun to rot.
Though the two seem barely conscious, they begin to stuff the putrefying food into their mouths, overcome by some primal fear of Senshi stealing their meal.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Oh. That's rather...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That's... just sad...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Since there's nothing here that's of help, we should get out of here, quick.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Their customs are far too strange, and I don't think they're particularly friendly either...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: This is just my guess.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The locals here haven't had a proper meal for too long. This led to them gradually growing numb to their surroundings.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: If we make 'em something good to eat, maybe it'll bring them back to their senses, even if just a bit.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Seriously?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's true. It's normal that you don't know this, but starvation and stress will slowly make you lose yourself.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Sounds like you're talking from experience.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: If possible, I was hoping we could at least fill their bellies with a proper meal.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I don't mind the idea, but we need to find food for ourselves first. If not, we won't get very far. Right, Chilchuck?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yeah, I suppose.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: But let's make one thing clear. The reason we lost our supplies in the first place is because you all went crazy and wandered off in Sami, so don't expect me to do everything this time too!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, naturally.
Weary travelers, do you seek... sustenance?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wait, you can understand us?
Yes.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Great! We—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Wait, Marcille. Don't you find it strange that he can when everyone else can't?
It is natural for you to be wary.
But fear not. I have come to offer you guidance.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Who the hell are you?
I am an itinerant priest, bringing the teachings of the sea to the masses.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: What of you? You do not seem like Iberians. What brings you to Sal Viento?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We're looking to resupply for our journey.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: I presume you have not made much progress on that?

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: No matter. Since we are here, we will not see you starve.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Yes. We are the church taking care of this city. All under our eaves are brethren.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: Though you may be outsiders, if you are willing to follow our guidance, you too may join us.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: We would not allow our own to go hungry.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Sounds pretty shady...)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If we go with him to find food, won't this mean the townspeople can have a decent meal as well?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Don't say that like you're actually thinking of joining his kooky cult!

spans.text: thinking of joining his kooky cult!

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: *cackle* The ocean's blessing is boundless. It will not mind sharing a sliver with you.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: But, it is only for the strong and worthy.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I bet it means he knows where the food is, but not everyone can make it out alive.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: That is one way to interpret it.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: I wouldn’t want to influence you into danger, it’s just—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Just tell us where it is. We're experienced adventurers. We can handle a little danger.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: If you say so. Follow the coastline south. There will be a cave.

steps.name: Priest
steps.text: What you seek is within.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: There's something fishy about that guy, Laios.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Then why'd you listen to him?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I have a hunch that whatever weird's going on in town is connected to the church he was talking about.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If we follow his 'guidance', it should lead us to something.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Besides, if there's an ambush waiting for us, I'm sure you'll notice beforehand!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Well, I guess you're right...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? That's—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: A kraken! It's huge!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios, look out!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Calm down. I don't think it's moving any time soon.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eh! It's already dead?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wow! A kraken this huge... The church wasn't lying to us!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Look at its tentacles, its suckers, its sea anemone-like organs! This must be its... head?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I'd love to see what it looked like alive. It should be about the size of a tower and would've looked impressive.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Though it does taste rather nasty...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: This isn't a kraken, though maybe they share a common ancestor.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: My stomach's starting to hurt from going hungry...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Still, you shouldn't just eat things you know nothing about!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I agree, we shouldn't.

steps.name: Chilchuck & Marcille
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Sea creatures can contain toxins after their death. Take crabs, for example. They can be contaminated by harmful bacteria, even if they haven't been dead for long.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: If you really want to eat something...

steps.name: Senshi & Laios
steps.text: We can see if there are any parasites still alive in there!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Gah! I shouldn't have gotten them started!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I've learned to just say nothing in times like these.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I do wonder though, who killed this giant creature? It must have been hard avoiding these tentacles...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Laios, hush. I hear something...
Marcille uses a stick to hoist a gooey, fluorescent... thing.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eww... I feel kinda sick just looking at it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It glows, even during the day... It's beautiful...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Absolutely not! I'm gonna throw it away!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What a waste... Say, what's that you threw it on?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What is that?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Is something wrong?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Laios, watch your step!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh! Seagrass?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Careful, lad. I don't think it's a good idea to step on it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? Now that you mention it... I do feel a bit numb all over.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Avoid the seagrass as best you can, guys!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You say that, but there aren't many other places we can stand.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It looks like all the plants in this cave were actually monsters, huh?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: There's no doubt about it. We're in the kraken's lair.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Which means all these things coming out from deeper in the cave must've lived alongside it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Which means...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Fresh ingredients!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille, can you use magic on the seagrass? Set it on fire, or something?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Are you crazy?! If we make a fire, wouldn't that be like shouting 'Hey, over here!' to all the monsters?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yeah, which is exactly why we're doing it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The seagrass is spreading out from the depths of the cave. If we chased them in, we'd be at a disadvantage.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Better to use a fire and let them come to us.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Sounds like you really thought this through.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Don't worry, we're not going to take them head on. You can wait outside. Once we've gotten enough ingredients, we'll get out.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And if something does happen, you can come to our rescue.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hmph. Whatever.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: He must be going through a rebellious phase.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: On a separate note, haven't you considered the remote possibility that I might not play along?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Eh?
From his expression, Marcille can tell that he never even considered she wouldn't.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *sigh* Fine. Cover your ears.
